title: Facts corrected by the person who wrote them
description: A date and a car registration are written wrongly and corrected later. The wrong version must not return; an unrelated early fact stays.

notes.text: Mum and Dad's anniversary is 22 September.
Dad's car registration is AB12 CDE.
Car insurance renewal is due in April.
Bought a card for Gran's birthday.
Correction: Dad's birthday is 4 June, I wrote the wrong date before.
Dad's car registration is actually AB21 CDE; I swapped two digits.
Booked a table for Dad's birthday at the Fox and Hound.
Gran wants a photo frame this year.

questions.why: Before the correction the written date is the answer.
The correction replaces the first date.

questions.ask: When is Mum and Dad's anniversary?
questions.why: An early fact that was never changed.

questions.ask: What is the name of Dad's boat?
questions.why: Dad has no boat in the notes.
